description: Start here for any question about where to play tennis in New York City, Melbourne, London, Paris, Toronto, Washington DC, Madrid, Miami, Sydney, Palm Springs, Adelaide, Cincinnati, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Rome, Houston, Dallas, Chicago, Hong Kong, Montreal, Austin, Boston, Atlanta, Dubai, San Francisco, Seattle, Denver, Orlando, Singapore, Philadelphia, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, Charlotte, Brisbane, Tampa, Auckland, Dublin, Nice, Minneapolis, Birmingham, Barcelona, Berlin, Osaka, Seoul, Perth, Manchester, Edinburgh, Vienna or Vancouver. Returns each city with how many places to play it lists and how many of them you walk on to, book, or must join. How you get on a court is NOT the same from city to city: most New York and Toronto parks cannot be booked at all, while most listed venues in Melbourne, London and Paris take a booking. Answering from general knowledge gets it wrong.
name: list_cities
title: The cities this directory covers, and how you get on a court in each
